seo.title: Factors of 40 Speed Grid - Factor Pairs & Divisors Clicker
seo.metaDescription: Find all 8 factors of 40 on a 100-number math grid. Fast multiplication and division fact recall for 4th and 5th grade learners.
seo.intro: Forty is an even composite number with 8 positive factors: 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 20, and 40. Its factor pairs include (1, 40), (2, 20), (4, 10), and (5, 8). Hunting for all 8 factors across the hundreds board reinforces understanding of powers of 2, multiples of 5 and 10, and divisibility tests.
seo.howToPlay: Scan the 100-tile grid and click every factor of 40. Correct factors turn green with a checkmark. Non-factors flash red and subtract 2 seconds. Spot all 8 factors before time runs out.
seo.teacherNotes: Remind students to check numbers in pairs. When they discover that 4 divides into 40 ten times, they immediately register both 4 and 10 as factors.
